raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
Related to #8197.

## Summary

Rollout prefill only needs the last position's logits to pick the first token. Two prefill call sites in `HybridEngineRollout` called the model without `logits_to_keep`, so the lm_head produced full `[batch, prompt_len, vocab]` logits:

- `_generate_graph` (graph-capture path)
- `_continuous_prefill_cache`, explicit static-cache branch (models that still expose `_supports_cache_class`)

This PR passes `logits_to_keep=1` when the model's `forward` declares the argument, mirroring how Transformers' `generate()` decides. Models without it are unchanged: their `**kwargs` may be forwarded to submodules, so the argument is not passed blindly. The `module.generate()` branch already does this internally and is untouched.

## Scope

- Graph-capture mode: always benefits (prefill calls the model directly).
- Continuous batching: benefits on Transformers versions that still expose `_supports_cache_class` and support `logits_to_keep` (>= 4.50). On Transformers 5.x this path goes through `module.generate()`, which already keeps only the last logits, so behavior is unchanged there.

## Measurements

Prefill forward with `StaticCache`. Random-weight Llama with vocab 151936, hidden 1024, 4 layers, bf16. 1× Intel Arc Pro B70.

| B × T | full logits | `logits_to_keep=1` | peak memory |
|---|---|---|---|
| 8 × 1024 | 141.7 ms | 43.3 ms | 2.46 → 0.32 GiB |
| 8 × 2048 | 279.0 ms | 79.6 ms | 4.92 → 0.64 GiB |
| 16 × 2048 | 544.7 ms | 149.5 ms | 9.84 → 1.27 GiB |

The selected first token is identical in all cases, and it matches the argmax of a plain HF forward. Small models gain the most because the lm_head dominates; for larger models the time saving shrinks, but the full-vocab activation is still avoided.

## Tests

- New `test_continuous_prefill_requests_last_logits_only`: a model following the Transformers `logits_to_keep` contract gets `logits_to_keep=1` at prefill, and the generated tokens are unchanged. The test fails without the change.
- `tests/unit/runtime/rollout/`: 63 passed, 1 skipped (CPU).


## Contribution checklist

**Related work.** This relates to #8197 (rollout profiling). A search for `logits_to_keep` and rollout prefill found no other PR.

**Sibling paths checked.** `HybridEngineRollout` has three prefill entry points:
- graph capture: changed;
- the explicit static-cache branch of continuous batching: changed;
- `module.generate()`: already keeps only the last logits, so it is untouched.

**Commands and results.**
```
pytest -p no:randomly tests/unit/runtime/rollout/
```
At head `fba8f9184`: 63 passed, 1 skipped, both with `DS_ACCELERATOR=cpu` and on 1× Intel Arc Pro B70 (XPU), Level Zero driver 1.15.39122 (compute runtime 26.27.39122.11), torch 2.14.0.dev20260804+xpu, transformers 5.17.0. The measurement table above was taken on the same B70 setup.

**Numerics, performance, memory.** The selected first token is unchanged. Time and peak-memory results are in the Measurements table above.

**Compatibility matrix.**

| | Validated | Not validated |
|---|---|---|
| Transformers | 5.17.0 (static-cache prefill on device) | The `_supports_cache_class` branch on <5.x is covered only by the unit test |
| Rollout path | Prefill forward on device; continuous prefill in the unit test | End-to-end graph-capture rollout on device |
| ZeRO | | Hybrid engine with ZeRO-3 |
| Precision | bf16 | fp16 |
| Accelerator | XPU, CPU | CUDA |

**AI assistance.** This PR was developed with AI assistance (GitHub Copilot CLI). I reviewed every changed line and ran the tests above.

@@ -1104,6 +1104,7 @@ def _continuous_prefill_cache(self, module, static_cache_type, prompt_ids, promp
             use_cache=True,
             cache_position=torch.arange(prompt_len, device=device),
             position_ids=position_ids,
+            **self._last_logits_kwargs(module),
         )
         return prefill_output.logits[:, -1, :].argmax(dim=-1, keepdim=True), prefill_cache
 
@@ -1137,6 +1138,15 @@ def _is_eos(self, token):
         eos_ids = torch.as_tensor(eos_token_id, dtype=token.dtype, device=token.device).flatten()
         return bool((token == eos_ids).any().item())
 
+    @staticmethod
+    def _last_logits_kwargs(module):
+        """Ask models that support it for last-position logits only, since prefill samples just one token."""
+        # Without this the prefill materializes [batch, prompt_len, vocab] logits, the largest activation of the
+        # rollout. Models that do not declare the argument may forward unknown kwargs to submodules, so skip them.
+        if "logits_to_keep" in signature(module.forward).parameters:
+            return {"logits_to_keep": 1}
+        return {}
+
     @staticmethod
     def _call_model(module, input_ids, **kwargs):
         """Call models with only the cache arguments their HF version accepts."""
@@ -1314,6 +1324,7 @@ def _generate_graph(self, prompt_ids, prompt_attn, max_new_tokens, pad_token_id,
             past_key_values=prefill_cache,
             use_cache=True,
             cache_position=torch.arange(prompt_len, device=device),
+            **self._last_logits_kwargs(module),
         )
         next_token = prefill_out.logits[:, -1, :].argmax(dim=-1, keepdim=True)

@@ -489,6 +489,56 @@ def forward(self, input_ids, attention_mask, past_key_values=None, use_cache=Tru
     assert (1, 3) in model.calls
 
 
+def test_continuous_prefill_requests_last_logits_only():
+
+    class LastLogitsModel(torch.nn.Module):
+        _supports_cache_class = True
+
+        def __init__(self):
+            super().__init__()
+            self.weight = torch.nn.Parameter(torch.zeros(1))
+            self.prefill_logits_to_keep = []
+
+            self.config = PretrainedConfig(
+                max_position_embeddings=32,
+                num_hidden_layers=1,
+                num_attention_heads=1,
+                num_key_value_heads=1,
+                hidden_size=1,
+                head_dim=1,
+            )
+
+        # Mirrors the Transformers contract: 0 returns logits for every position, k for the last k.
+        def forward(self,
+                    input_ids,
+                    attention_mask,
+                    past_key_values=None,
+                    use_cache=True,
+                    cache_position=None,
+                    position_ids=None,
+                    logits_to_keep=0):
+            key_states = input_ids[:, None, :, None].to(dtype=torch.float32)
+            past_key_values.update(key_states,
+                                   key_states,
+                                   layer_idx=0,
+                                   cache_kwargs={"cache_position": cache_position})
+            if input_ids.shape[1] > 1:
+                self.prefill_logits_to_keep.append(logits_to_keep)
+            # Each position predicts its own token + 5, so reading any position but the last changes the output.
+            logits = torch.nn.functional.one_hot((input_ids + 5) % 16, num_classes=16).to(torch.float32)
+            if logits_to_keep:
+                logits = logits[:, -logits_to_keep:]
+            return SimpleNamespace(logits=logits, past_key_values=past_key_values)
+
+    model = LastLogitsModel()
+    rollout = HybridEngineRollout(SimpleNamespace(module=model), SimpleNamespace(pad_token_id=0, eos_token_id=2))
+    request = RolloutRequest(torch.tensor([[1, 2, 3], [1, 2, 4]]), torch.ones((2, 3), dtype=torch.long))
+    output = rollout.generate(request, SamplingConfig(max_new_tokens=2, temperature=0, continuous_batch_size=2))
+
+    assert output.input_ids[:, 3:].tolist() == [[8, 13], [9, 14]]
+    assert model.prefill_logits_to_keep == [1]
+
+
